Walk-In-Interview
Walk-In-Interview for the post of Assistant Professor as Guest Faculty in the
subject of Political Science for Panjab University Constituent College, Vill.
Karyal, Dharamkot (Moga) will be conducted on 27/08/2024 (09:30 AM) at
Panjab University Regional Centre Ludhiana (Near Fountain Chowk, Opposite
Pavilion Mall).
Salary: - Panjab University/Punjab Govt.Regulations.
Qualifications: as per Panjab Univerity/UGC norms.
Important Instructions:
1. Interested candidates are advised to download application Proforma from
P.U. website, filled and affix one latest passport size colour photograph,
attached one set of photocopy of all documents (self-attested) and bring on the
interview venue.
2. Application Proforma for Direct recruitment of Assistant Professor (AS per
UGC Regulation 2018) can be download from Pajab University Jobs site:
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php.
3. On the interview date candidates are advised to carry all original documents
for verification.
4. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing interview.
Note: - Interested candidates send their resume upto 22/08/2024 (10:00
A.M) to puccdharmkot@gmail.com
Sd/-
Principal
PUCC,Karyal,Dharamkot (Moga)
